01 / Professional profile

Security that supports the business.

My background spans corporate, industrial, aviation and transport security. I combine operational leadership with physical security technology, commercial responsibility and a practical approach to protecting people, assets and operations.

02 / Independent concept development

From security requirements to implementation.

I independently develop tailored security concepts that connect organizational measures, physical protection and technical systems with operational needs and business objectives.

My approach is to understand the environment, identify vulnerabilities, define proportionate measures and coordinate practical implementation with the relevant stakeholders.
